answer: For a poll on an opal sculpture in the violet grove, the server checks escrowed bids, rejects unfunded bids and counts the ten highest funded ballots, breaking ties randomly. Each winner pays the eleventh-highest bid; others are refunded. With fewer than eleven funded bids, all are refunded and no ballots count. If an honest losing bid is $10, each winning attacker ballot costs at least $10. Wealth can dominate, and losing voters have no influence.
